description: Source code for the ModeSelector class, which manages head tracking modes and pose calculations in an Android media context.

classes.name: ModeSelector
classes.description: Class responsible for selecting and calculating head tracking modes and related poses.

methods.name: setDesiredMode
methods.description: Sets the desired head tracking mode.

methods.name: setScreenToStagePose
methods.description: Sets the pose from screen to stage.

methods.name: setScreenToHeadPose
methods.description: Sets the pose from screen to head with timestamp.

methods.name: setWorldToHeadPose
methods.description: Sets the pose from world to head with timestamp.

methods.name: setScreenStable
methods.description: Sets the stability status of the screen with timestamp.

methods.name: calculateActualMode
methods.description: Calculates the current head tracking mode based on pose freshness and stability.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Performs mode calculation and updates head to stage pose.

methods.name: getHeadToStagePose
methods.description: Returns the current head to stage pose.

methods.name: getActualMode
methods.description: Returns the current head tracking mode.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ModeSelector state.
